voiceReason: Kevin’s wish to be helpful and Lan’s anxious ambition allow gentle humour to give way to attentive responsibility.
objective: Compare two responses to a community need using their benefits and costs.
successCriterion: Explain a benefit and a cost for two responses, using a specific episode detail; defend a judgement without assuming that more control or less action is always better.

characterSignatures.Kevin: Self-questioning, short concrete questions; light humour gives way to firm warnings; reaches to help, then listens.
characterSignatures.Lan: Counts tasks and seeks approval; under pressure asks direct questions about losing her work; busy hands become still at Fang’s offer.
characterSignatures.Auntie: Practical, specific, dry humour; speaks about time, grain and a stool, not abstract slogans.
characterSignatures.Fang: Courteous confidence becomes patient admission; takes a supporting task rather than directing every hand.
characterSignatures.Wei: Brief descriptions of what he can see; gives limited, concrete instructions and accepts useful local information.

directing: Lan/Fang pair → Fang asks why residents are tired → listener Lan admits one more improvement → hold her stopped hand → return to pair.
After canopy response: Lan expects dismissal → Fang offers a different responsibility → listener Lan holds the basket → she asks whether he will listen publicly.
physicalWork: Supported reach/give/bow gestures accompany grain carrying, gate work, ribbon sorting or basket work; unnamed objects are narrated/mimed rather than claimed visible props. Ordinary exchanges use two-shots.

storyCircle.want: Lan wants secure employment through a successful welcome.
storyCircle.pressure: The plan’s growing demands harm the people it should welcome.
storyCircle.change: Lan begins to ask what help is needed and whether others can refuse.
storyCircle.payoff: The first task returns in Lan’s last conversation; ceremony and danger choices yield distinct costs and consequences. All routes resolve the immediate hazard and safely return Kevin.
storyCircle.freshQuestion: How will tomorrow’s promises be checked once the visitor is gone?

teaser.label: welcome_opening_v1
teaser.moment: The canopy support shifts as a ribbon pulls tight.

branches: Six choices, three options each, forward rejoins, distinct replies, no moral score.
presentationSuitability: Concrete details, competing values and costs appear on every route; optional synthesis can compare these two cases.
